title: Ben L'Oncle Soul Supplied An Outstanding Single Track, "Is It You?"
htmlContent:
French soul troubadour Ben L'Oncle Soul has just released his latest album, "Is It You?" The album was written and composed by Ben L'Oncle Soul in collaboration with Gunnar Ellwanger and engineered by Grammy Award-winning producer Scott Jacoby. The intimate album features nine tracks that showcase his enchanting voice, glorious lyricism, and unforgettable melodies.

"Is It You?" is a personal album recorded live at the world-renowned Red House in Champagne-Ardenne with Ben L'Oncle Soul's beloved tour band, the shock team. The album features the recently released singles "A Rose," "Sky Has Open Doors," and "Levitate," which have received rave reviews from fans and critics alike, amassing over half a million plays online.

The album is a beautiful blend of R&B, jazz, and soul music that will delight fans of the genre. Ben L'Oncle Soul's unique voice and style are on full display, making "Is It You?" a must-listen for any soul music fan.
